name: Guard
why: An agent's tool call, through the repo's guards, to run or blocked
ideal: Guards block one-way doors and machine policy, each block names its fix, false alarms become tests, and a guard change adds one regression case.

steps.name: Call
steps.rule: Deny rules and hooks block only one-way-door commands; most calls pass untouched.

steps.name: Block
steps.rule: A block names its fix, so the session moves on in seconds.

steps.name: Message
steps.rule: A block's message is short: the rule and the fix, nothing more.

steps.name: False alarm
tools: A guard test per false alarm
steps.rule: A block on a safe command is a false alarm, and it becomes a guard test.

steps.name: Change
steps.rule: A guard fix lands with one regression case under the normal review, and a new rule needs a real incident.
